name.description: Identifier name for the drive instance

remote.description: Rclone remote name with trailing colon (e.g. 'gdrive:').

drive_letter.description: Windows drive letter with trailing colon (e.g. 'E:').

volume_name.description: Volume display label visible in Windows File Explorer.

cache_dir.description: Local path for VFS file caching. Recommend redirecting away from system C: drive.

cache_size.description: Maximum size cap for the local disk cache (e.g. '20G').

buffer_size.description: Memory buffer size per open file stream (e.g. '16M').

read_chunk_size.description: Initial chunk size requested during sequential streaming.

read_chunk_limit.description: Maximum chunk size ceiling for streaming requests.

read_only.description: Mount as read-only volume if true.
